title: Understanding the Design Matrix
text: The design matrix $X$ includes all the features of the data set plus an additional column for the intercept. If $X$ has $n$ columns, how many of these columns represent the actual features of the data?

title: Counting the Features
text: If the design matrix $X$ has $n$ columns, and one of these columns is for the intercept, how many columns are left for the features?
